feedback: Excellent execution of the Swiss/International style spec across all 8 pages. Strong fidelity: vertical ATP/1957→ lockup, 12-col grid with visible baseline lines, oversized red issue numerals (№ 042) on essays, inventory numbers in red, BibTeX citation block on Objekt-Detail, manifesto numbered list (01–07) on Über uns, drop cap + red pull quote border + sticky TOC on Essay-Detail, historical Swiss grids comparison on Raster-System, and contact form + Öffnungszeiten table + map placeholder on Kontakt. All German labels present. Minor issues that prevent a 10: (1) the homepage H1 wraps to 7 lines and is so oversized it dominates the viewport — spec wanted oversized but this is excessive; (2) at the 768px tablet viewport, archive cards collapse to 2-per-row but the spec calls for 3-per-row; (3) the curatorial note on Objekt-Detail is only 4 short paragraphs rather than '3 paragraphs' of long-form depth; (4) missing favicon causes a 404 in the console; (5) the data table on Objekt-Detail sits inside columns 8–12 but uses a 2-column key/value table rather than the spec's structured tabular flush-right metadata feel. Overall a rigorous, intellectually faithful realization of the brief.
